title: Quartz
body:
Description

Quartz is an ore you can find on high elevations on Finlay Island and in the Quartz Cave within Mike's Mines. Quartz ore can spawn in Marble and Lavaslate nodes.

The raw form of Quartz takes on a white color similar to Marble.

Trivia

  • Quartz's refined form has the same appearance as it's forged form.
  • Similar to Marble, Quartz in its forged form is also very slippery and will slide around if thrown with great velocity.
